spreads.scene: A child stands by a gate, waving. On the right, a small group of animals approaches, looking excited. The ground is grassy, with a fence in the middle ground, and a clear sky above.
A child stands on one leg, arms up, dancing. On the right, a cricket in the same pose, dancing. The ground is a patio, with low bushes in the middle ground, and a bright sky.

A child stands with mouth open, hands clasped, singing. On the right, a frog on a lily pad in the same pose, singing. The ground is wet grass, with a pond in the middle ground, and trees in the background.
A child sits on a low wall, smiling happily. On the right, a small bird on a branch in the same pose, smiling. The ground is a path, with a garden wall in the middle ground, and a leafy tree.

A child holds a knife, poised to cut a cake on a table. On the right, a group of small animals sits patiently, watching the cake. The ground is a picnic blanket, with a table in the middle ground, and a clear sky.
A child holds out a slice of cake on a plate. On the right, a small ant reaches out to take a crumb. The ground is a wooden deck, with a table in the middle ground, and a potted plant.

A child holds a plate with multiple cake slices, offering them to others. On the right, several small animals are reaching for their own cake pieces. The ground is a grassy patch, with a low table, and flowers blooming.

A child holds a piece of cake to their mouth, eating. On the right, a frog on a leaf holds a small crumb to its mouth, eating. The ground is by a pond, with large leaves in the middle ground, and reeds.
A child sips from a small cup. On the right, a bird sips from a water droplet on a leaf. The ground is a paved patio, with a bird bath in the middle ground, and a small bush.
A child carries a small empty plate. On the right, an ant carries a tiny cake crumb. The ground is a dirt path, with pebbles in the middle ground, and a few blades of grass.
A child waves goodbye, with an arm raised. On the right, the group of animals waves back, some with tiny paws. The ground is a garden path, with a fence in the middle ground, and a sunset sky.

A child is asleep in a bed, covered by a blanket. On the right, the various animals are also asleep in their natural habitats. The ground is a floor, with a bed in the middle ground, and a window showing a night sky.
